extra.message: Hardcoded Demo Credentials — An attacker can log in as admin, agent, team_lead, or customer using the revealed credentials, leading to full compromise of the system (admin access, data exfiltration, unauthorized actions). [verified: The login page displays hardcoded demo email/password pairs for admin, agent, team_lead, and customer (frontend/src/pages/Login.tsx:43). These credentials are accepted by the backend (seeded by seed.py) and allow an attacker to log in as any role, including admin, providing full system access.]

Hardcoded Default JWT Secret Allows Token Forging — An attacker can forge valid JWT tokens for any user ID and role, gaining full unauthorized access to all user data, tickets, internal notes, administrative functions, and sensitive assets such as API keys and webhook secrets. [verified: Line 12 hardcodes a default JWT secret when SECRET_KEY env var is missing. An attacker aware of this default can forge arbitrary JWT tokens, bypassing all authentication and role checks (e.g., get_current_user at line 50).]
